summary: Doki Doki Literature Club entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Doki Doki Literature Club!
entries.definitive_edition: Original free PC release for historical play; DDLC Plus for expanded side content

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PC release for exact presentation; Plus for HD extras

primary.why: The original PC release is the historically exact route for Doki Doki Literature Club's file-system-aware meta-horror. DDLC Plus adds HD visuals and new side stories, but it is a distinct expanded release rather than a perfect substitute for the original.
primary.how_to_play: Use the original PC release on Steam or ddlc.moe for the main historical route. Record whether DDLC Plus is also played for side stories and gallery content.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PC release and historical meta-presentation.
Expanded HD release with side stories, music player, and unlockable gallery.
all_releases.reason: secondary: include for complete official expanded content, but keep separate from the original meta route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The original PC build is historically exact; Plus is more feature-complete but changes the framing and adds new side content.

entries.remaster_caveats: DDLC Plus should be documented as an expanded rerelease, not a transparent replacement for the original PC meta-horror route.
